headline: Approved the April 21, 2026 meeting minutes and decided to keep tourism work at OPED instead of partnering with the Chamber.
summary: Members talked about a Small Business Saturday event that would feature Holyoke businesses, possibly after Thanksgiving. They also discussed pausing DOH 2026 because The Brick Race moved to the spring. Other ideas included hiring interns for Explore Holyoke and adding a food truck day at Amour Yard in 2027.
decisions: Decided to keep the tourism committee at OPED rather than partner with The Chamber.

decision_evidence.quote: The minutes for April 21 ,2026 were approved unanimously, and the motion carried forward 5-0.
Denis Luzuriaga brought up the idea of TAC partnering with The Chamber, but it was decided that it would be best to keep TAC at OPED.

decision_titles: Possible partnership with The Chamber of Commerce
